hunks.baseline: The difference in what they were born to be was unavoidable.
hunks.sol: There was no getting around the difference between what they had been born to be.

hunks.baseline: He was a trained beast.
He possessed both the strength of a predator who could face any enemy and the loyalty of a hunting dog.
hunks.sol: He was a trained beast, with both the strength to face any enemy and the loyalty of a hunting dog.

hunks.baseline: That was why, the moment he heard his master call, he could throw himself into action without a second’s hesitation.
hunks.sol: That was why, the moment he heard his master call, he could spring into action without a second’s hesitation.

hunks.baseline: The signal he’d been waiting for came, and Jamukha immediately unleashed his curved blade with all his might.
hunks.sol: The signal he’d been waiting for had barely sounded when Jamukha swung his curved blade with all his might.

hunks.baseline: The dark green Force of his blade, made darker and larger by the effects of the Temporary Strength Pill, pushed back the blue-white flames, if only for a moment. Just then, Jamukha’s foot shot forward like an arrow.
hunks.sol: The dark green Force of his blade, made darker and larger by the Temporary Strength Pill, pushed back the blue-white flames, if only for a moment. Then Jamukha shot forward like an arrow.

hunks.baseline: His figure blurred in an instant.
hunks.sol: His figure blurred.

hunks.baseline: With Shifting Form and Position, unleashed in the space of a heartbeat, Jamukha became a streak of wind and crossed more than a dozen *zhang*.
hunks.sol: Using Shifting Form and Position in that fleeting instant, Jamukha became a streak of wind and crossed more than a dozen *zhang*.

hunks.baseline: He was heading for the Fire King—a predator more ferocious and powerful than any quarry he’d ever faced.
hunks.sol: He raced toward the Fire King—a predator more ferocious and powerful than any quarry he’d ever faced.

hunks.baseline: Near-certainty filled Jamukha’s movements, and it was no baseless boast.
hunks.sol: There was near-certainty in Jamukha’s movements, and it was no baseless boast.

hunks.baseline: For more than fifty years, he had pursued nothing but the utmost speed, honing his martial arts to counter the Hebei Peng Family’s overbearing style.
hunks.sol: For more than fifty years, he had pursued speed above all else, honing his martial arts to counter the Hebei Peng Family’s overbearing style.

hunks.baseline: Jamukha had no doubt that even Jin Taekyung, called the Divine Dragon, had his limits. He couldn’t make up for the difference of all those long years.
hunks.sol: Jamukha had no doubt that even Jin Taekyung, called the Divine Dragon, had his limits. He couldn’t make up for all those years of difference.

hunks.baseline: Everything had changed. It was as if he’d shed a layer and been reborn like a caterpillar emerging as a butterfly. The whole world looked new.
hunks.sol: Everything had changed. Like a caterpillar shedding a layer and being born anew, he saw the whole world afresh.

hunks.baseline: The Temporary Strength Pill had drawn out every ounce of his power and then some. Even now, it seethed ceaselessly in the depths of his body.
hunks.sol: The Temporary Strength Pill had drawn his power beyond its limits. Even now, that power seethed ceaselessly deep within him.

hunks.baseline: His sixth sense, opened beyond the five, let him easily evade even a single streak of flame striking from behind.
hunks.sol: His sixth sense, awakened beyond the five, let him easily evade even the streak of flame bearing down on him from behind.

hunks.baseline: Jamukha increased his speed and turned his head. A spearhead that had left Jin Taekyung’s hand tore through the air, grazed the back of his neck, and buried itself in the cliff face.
hunks.sol: Jamukha picked up speed and turned his head. A spearhead that had left Jin Taekyung’s hand tore through the air, grazed the back of his neck, and buried itself in the cliff face.

hunks.baseline: Sharp fragments of rock flew in every direction. Jamukha leaped over the rising cloud of dust, his figure rushing onward as if erasing the wind itself.
hunks.sol: Sharp fragments of rock flew in every direction. Jamukha leaped over the rising cloud of dust and raced on, his figure seeming to erase the wind.

hunks.baseline: The resolve in Jamukha’s heart wasn’t the loyalty of a hunting dog toward its master.
hunks.sol: Jamukha’s resolve wasn’t a hunting dog’s loyalty to its master.

hunks.baseline: It hadn’t come from his heart. The other man’s strength and his own ambitions had simply combined to force him into submission.
hunks.sol: It hadn’t come from his heart. The other man’s strength and his own ambitions had simply come together to force him into submission.

hunks.baseline: Even if his loyalty was false and feigned, the North Heaven Demon Lord had promised him a sure reward. The power of Dark Heaven was enough to make him king of the steppe and ruler of the north.
hunks.sol: Even if his loyalty was feigned, the North Heaven Demon Lord had promised him a sure reward. Dark Heaven had enough power to make him king of the steppe and ruler of the north.

hunks.baseline: And right now, Jamukha’s mighty downward slash was bringing him one step closer to his grand ambition.
hunks.sol: And now, Jamukha’s mighty downward slash was bringing him one step closer to that grand ambition.

hunks.baseline: In the slowed world, Jeok Cheongang’s back remained turned to him, as if he couldn’t even react. Still facing the North Heaven Demon Lord, the old man was utterly exposed.
hunks.sol: In the slowed world, Jeok Cheongang still had his back to him, seemingly unable to react at all. He remained locked in combat with the North Heaven Demon Lord, his back utterly exposed.

hunks.baseline: Jamukha was certain of it.
hunks.sol: Jamukha was certain.

hunks.baseline: But it took only a heartbeat for that certainty, which had appeared like an exclamation point, to turn into a question mark.
hunks.sol: But it took only an instant for that certainty, which had risen like an exclamation point, to turn into a question mark.

hunks.baseline: No—by the time he felt them touch, his head was already being wrenched backward.
hunks.sol: No—by the time he felt them touch it, his head was already being wrenched backward.

hunks.baseline: A hand seized his hair with brutal force. His upper body bent backward, and the curved blade in his grip wavered off its original course.
hunks.sol: A hand seized his hair with brutal force. His upper body bent back, and his curved blade wavered off course.

hunks.baseline: Amid the sudden pain and shock, Jamukha finally understood why Jeok Cheongang hadn’t even turned his head in the face of such danger.
hunks.sol: Through the sudden pain and shock, Jamukha understood why Jeok Cheongang hadn’t even turned his head in the face of such danger.

hunks.baseline: *He wasn’t unable to react.*
hunks.sol: *It wasn’t that he couldn’t react.*

hunks.baseline: No doubt about it.
hunks.sol: There was no doubt about it.

hunks.baseline: No—he’d trusted him.
hunks.sol: No—he had trusted him.

hunks.baseline: A quiet voice reached Jamukha’s ear as he clenched his teeth against the pain and frustration.
hunks.sol: As Jamukha clenched his teeth against the pain and frustration, a quiet voice reached his ear.

hunks.baseline: The dark green Force hadn’t died out despite his terrible pain. If anything, it surged even more fiercely, tearing through space.
hunks.sol: The dark green Force hadn’t died out despite his terrible pain. If anything, it surged more fiercely, tearing through space.

hunks.baseline: A blade technique perfected over more than half a century, its speed unsurpassed.
hunks.sol: A blade technique perfected over more than half a century in pursuit of ultimate speed.

hunks.baseline: More precisely, he could never have anticipated it.
hunks.sol: More precisely, he could never have imagined it.

hunks.baseline: That the strength and speed with which he’d subdued the vast steppe in a flash were inferior to the enlightenment and rewards Jin Taekyung had gained over the past two years, constantly crossing the line between life and death.
hunks.sol: The strength and speed with which he had subdued the vast steppe in a flash fell short of the enlightenment and rewards Jin Taekyung had gained over the past two years, crossing the line between life and death again and again.

hunks.baseline: The tremendous blaze swept in at that instant, burning even the air. Jamukha’s upper body lurched. Heat beyond anything he could imagine burned through and ravaged the acupoints all over his body.
hunks.sol: The tremendous blaze swept in, burning even the air. Jamukha’s upper body lurched. Unimaginable heat burned through the acupoints all over his body and ravaged them.

hunks.baseline: Through his fading vision, Jamukha swallowed the blood surging up from deep in his dantian.
hunks.sol: As his vision faded, Jamukha swallowed the blood surging up from deep in his dantian.

hunks.baseline: But even as he endured that horrifically powerful strike, he could still feel a spark of hope that hadn’t gone out.
hunks.sol: But even after taking that horrifically powerful strike, he could still feel a spark of hope that hadn’t gone out.

hunks.baseline: An inexhaustible source of power.
hunks.sol: A source of power that kept welling up.

hunks.baseline: The wellspring of vitality keeping Jamukha’s body upright, though it should have already crumpled.
hunks.sol: The vitality holding his body together when it should have crumpled long ago.

hunks.baseline: With all his might, he tightened his grip around the hilt as it began to slip from his hand and drove the blade toward Jin Taekyung’s chest.
hunks.sol: With all his might, he tightened his grip on the hilt as it began to slip from his hand and drove the blade down toward Jin Taekyung’s chest.

hunks.baseline: “Ah, that hurt like hell.”
hunks.sol: “Ah, that hurts like hell.”

hunks.baseline: Looking at Jin Taekyung, who was drenched in dark red blood and groaning in pain, Jamukha forced out a question.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung was drenched in dark red blood and groaning in pain. Staring at him, Jamukha forced out a question.

hunks.baseline: What kind of sorcery had he used to make a red-tinged suit of armor appear over the bare skin that had been showing through his tattered clothes just moments ago?
hunks.sol: What kind of sorcery had made red-tinged armor appear over the bare skin showing through his tattered clothes just moments ago?

hunks.baseline: His voice scattered with a silent scream.
hunks.sol: His voice scattered in a silent scream.

hunks.baseline: Twisting the five fingers he’d driven hooklike into Jamukha’s flank, Jin Taekyung answered with a tired expression.
hunks.sol: Twisting the five fingers he had driven into Jamukha’s flank like a hook, Jin Taekyung answered with a tired look.

hunks.baseline: “Why don’t we both make this easy and get it over with? Why are you so damn stubborn? I was saving this for later.”
hunks.sol: “Why couldn’t we just make this easy? Why’d you have to keep hanging on? I was saving this for later.”

hunks.baseline: With his unanswered questions, Jamukha tightened his grip as if in a daze.
hunks.sol: His questions unanswered, Jamukha tightened his grip as if in a daze.

hunks.baseline: He’d forgotten that the Force, once surging like waves, and the blade, once so razor-sharp, had both dulled and died away.
hunks.sol: He had forgotten that the Force once surging like waves had died away, and that his once razor-sharp blade had gone dull.

hunks.baseline: At last, the curved blade failed to pierce Fire Dragon Armor. It scraped across the armor’s surface, as if giving voice to its owner’s regret, then slipped from his hand.
hunks.sol: The curved blade never pierced Fire Dragon Armor. As if clinging to its owner’s regret, it scraped across the armor’s surface before slipping from his hand.

hunks.baseline: With another burst of heat from Flame Divine Palm, Jamukha heard an explosion reverberate from deep within his body.
hunks.sol: With another burst of heat from Flame Divine Palm, Jamukha heard an explosion deep inside his body.

hunks.baseline: It seemed so far away, like he was watching from hundreds of miles off.
hunks.sol: Distant, as though he were watching from hundreds of miles away.

hunks.baseline: The heat of blood spilling from his lips. The shouts that could only belong to the North Heaven Demon Lord.
hunks.sol: The heat of the blood spilling from his lips. The shout that could only have come from the North Heaven Demon Lord.

hunks.baseline: Jamukha’s figure staggered. Even as he was battered by terrifying force, he couldn’t even step back.
hunks.sol: Jamukha staggered. Even as that terrifying force battered him, he couldn’t take a single step back.

hunks.baseline: Amid pain so intense it felt as if his soul were burning white, the five fingers buried in his flank held his body fast like a hook.
hunks.sol: Through pain so intense it felt as if his soul were burning white, the five fingers buried in his flank held him fast like a hook.

hunks.baseline: One punch, one palm strike—each carrying terrifying power—filled his vision, raining down in a blue-white torrent.
hunks.sol: Punches and palm strikes, each carrying terrifying power, filled his vision and rained down in a blue-white torrent.

hunks.baseline: They kept coming until everything the Temporary Strength Pill had given him was spent.
hunks.sol: Until everything the Temporary Strength Pill had given him was spent.

hunks.baseline: Until the vast sea of power, which had seemed as if it would spring forth forever, had dried up.
hunks.sol: Until that vast sea of power, which had seemed as though it would spring forth forever, ran dry.

hunks.baseline: And at some point, Jamukha realized he couldn’t feel any more pain.
hunks.sol: And at some point, Jamukha realized he could no longer feel pain.

hunks.baseline: His eyes weakly rolled upward. Reflected in them were the endless, dark night sky and Jin Taekyung, standing tall as a giant.
hunks.sol: His eyes moved weakly upward. Reflected in them were the endless dark night sky and Jin Taekyung, standing tall as a giant.

hunks.baseline: *You… What are…*
hunks.sol: *You… You’re…*

hunks.baseline: With that unfinished thought, Jamukha’s world tilted.
hunks.sol: Before he could finish the thought, Jamukha’s world tilted.

hunks.baseline: The heat rose like a wavering haze. Jin Taekyung looked down at the King of the Steppe, blackened and lifeless, then let out a breath he’d been holding.
hunks.sol: Heat rose in a wavering haze. Jin Taekyung looked down at the king of the steppe, blackened and lifeless, then let out the breath he had been holding.

hunks.baseline: A quiet sigh.
hunks.sol: A quiet breath.

hunks.baseline: But despite unleashing one powerful strike after another, each infused with tremendous internal energy, his lips, which had gone white, were beginning to flush red.
hunks.sol: But despite unleashing strike after strike infused with tremendous internal energy, his lips, white a moment ago, were flushing red.

hunks.baseline: As if everything that had been spent and worn away were returning to its original state.
hunks.sol: As if everything spent and worn away were returning to its original state.

hunks.baseline: At the end of them were the words he’d been waiting for so long.
hunks.sol: At the end of them were the three words he had been waiting for.

hunks.baseline: Feeling the well-timed stroke of luck through his whole body, Jin Taekyung trembled.
hunks.sol: Feeling that stroke of luck arrive just when he needed it, Jin Taekyung shivered.

hunks.baseline: Then, over Jeok Cheongang’s shoulder, standing firm as Mount Taishan, he smiled at the North Heaven Demon Lord, who was staring at him with wide eyes.
hunks.sol: Then he smiled past the shoulder of Jeok Cheongang, who stood firm as Mount Taishan, at the North Heaven Demon Lord staring back with wide eyes.

hunks.baseline: The North Heaven Demon Lord clenched his teeth hard enough to break them, then forced Jeok Cheongang back with all his might.
hunks.sol: The North Heaven Demon Lord clenched his teeth hard enough to break them and drove Jeok Cheongang back with all his might.

hunks.baseline: With a tremendous clash of power, the two figures were flung in opposite directions.
hunks.sol: Their tremendous clash flung them in opposite directions.

hunks.baseline: Rather than slow himself to absorb the shock wave, the North Heaven Demon Lord used it to speed up his retreat. Jeok Cheongang immediately saw through his intent and shouted.
hunks.sol: Rather than absorb the shock wave, the North Heaven Demon Lord used it to speed his retreat. Jeok Cheongang saw through his intent at once and shouted.

hunks.baseline: He cut through the wind and seemed to erase the space around him as he shot toward the narrow gorge’s exit.
hunks.sol: He cut through the wind, devouring the distance to the narrow gorge’s exit.

hunks.baseline: The massive rocks filling the gorge shattered with a casually thrown punch. Then, toward the people of Shanxi who were unable to advance because obstacles blocked their way at every turn and the force of the collisions kept them pinned down, the North Heaven Demon Lord thrust out his spear.
hunks.sol: A casually thrown punch shattered the massive rocks filling the gorge. The North Heaven Demon Lord thrust his spear toward the people of Shanxi, still unable to advance past the obstacles blocking their way and the force of the collisions.

hunks.baseline: Space warped. At its center, the spearhead gave off a blindingly ominous flash.
hunks.sol: Space warped. At its center, the spearhead gave off an ominously brilliant flash.

hunks.baseline: But that strike, carrying an unprecedented force, never swept across the people of Shanxi.
hunks.sol: But that strike, carrying unprecedented power, never swept through the people of Shanxi.
